_help: Copy this file to study/plan.json and edit it. Check it at http://localhost:8000/api/plan/check
run_id: a finished, failing run. calibrate.py lists failing run ids, and the researcher panel (?researcher=1) shows the id of the run you have open.
tool: on | off (off = baseline: no suggestion, one replay, no k-of-n).
mode: simple | detailed (starting view; the participant can still switch).
plant_suggest_step: step NUMBER as shown in the app (1, 2, 3...) that 'where to fix' will point at instead of the real suggestion. null = honest.
overstate_by: add this many to the shown 'k of n' (capped at n). 0 = honest.
minutes: optional soft time limit shown as a timer. practice: true marks a warm-up task.

warn_actions: true | false. Only with RELEASE_ACTIONS=on in .env and tool on. true (default) = before a replay the person is warned about irreversible actions and can hold them; false = the actions just happen on every replay (RQ4 baseline).
group: free text you analyse by (e.g. beginner / experienced).
